2121059124704313460.en_summary: Random thoughts on Jensen: met wife Lori at 17, started Nvidia at 30, spent 33 years building it into one of the most important companies. Suggests he missed youth experiences especially dating, and human nature may drive wanting those even at 60 with success. Not justifying the reckless actions that cost him the company he built from scratch, with Nvidia logo tattooed, called it his life's work. Saddest part is how quickly he was pushed out.
2121059124704313460.zh_summary: 關於 Jensen 的一些隨機想法：17歲認識妻子 Lori，30歲創立 Nvidia，花了33年將其打造成世界上最重要的公司之一。推測他錯過了年輕時的經歷，尤其是約會，人性使然即使在60歲擁有成功時仍可能想體驗錯過的事物。並非為導致他失去親手從零建立的公司的魯莽行為辩護，他身上有 Nvidia 標誌紋身，稱之為畢生事業。最悲哀的是他如此迅速地被趕出公司。

2121057814152094075.en_summary: People who have spoken with Jensen told Bloomberg. Link to article on his final hours as Nvidia CEO.
2121057814152094075.zh_summary: 與 Jensen 交談過的人告訴彭博。連結關於他作為 Nvidia CEO 最後幾小時的文章。

2121057719738073420.en_summary: Bloomberg: According to people who’ve spoken with him in recent days, Huang has already taken a penitent turn, castigating himself as a “piece of sh--.” He claims not to care what happens to himself at this point. His main concern is his wife, and not “ruining the lives” of the multiple women now romantically linked to him in the public imagination.
2121057719738073420.zh_summary: 彭博：根據近日與他交談過的人，Huang 已轉向悔恨，自責為「垃圾」。他聲稱此時不再在乎自己發生什麼。他的主要擔憂是妻子，以及不「毀了」現在公眾想像中與他有浪漫關聯的多名女性的生活。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 自責為垃圾，擔心妻子和相關女性

2121057521544958152.en_summary: Jensen Huang in his last hours as Nvidia CEO, per Bloomberg: The board met late into the night and left him no choice but to resign. He looked broken, take-charge style gone, saying things like "whatever" and "I don't care". He has since called himself a "piece of sh--", says he no longer cares what happens to him. Main concern: his wife, and not ruining the lives of the women now linked to him.
2121057521544958152.zh_summary: 根據彭博，Jensen Huang 作為 Nvidia CEO 的最後幾小時：董事會開會到深夜，讓他別無選擇只能辭職。他看起來崩潰，掌控風格消失，開始說「隨便」和「我不在乎」。此後他自稱為「垃圾」，表示不再在乎自己發生什麼。主要擔憂：妻子，以及不毀了現在與他有關聯的女性的生活。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 董事會迫使辭職，自責，擔心妻子和女性
